topics.title: 2025 INFL TA Key Milestone Overview – Overall Status (May 14, 2025)

background.text: As of May 14, 2025, all activities in the 2025 INFL TA milestone plan are on track. Key milestones include Nerandomilast IPF NDA submission (Sep 2025), PPF NDA submission, chILD Ph3 1st SIV, CatCi FPFV/FPI/FPFT, Spesolimab PG Ph3 SIV, cGAS Ph2 INF CTA submission, and others. Some items are on-hold or postponed: FIBRONEER-SARD Ph3b 1st SIV (on-hold, TBU); chILD Ph3 HAI meeting request submission (postponed, TBU); NOX-4 inh. Ph2 early ILD CTA submission (on-hold, TBU). Spesolimab NS sNDA submission and BTD & pre-NDA are discontinued.
background.quote:
Status May 14th, 2025:
All activities on track

topics.title: cGAS inhibitor BI 3000202 – Early Integration Plan for IFNopathy and SLE (Ph2)

background.text: BI 3000202 (cGAS inhibitor) is in Ph1c for IFNopathy. Ph2 DRF study planned in IFNopathy and SLE; Ph3 planned in IFNopathy and SSc. TALC endorsed Ph2 DRF in SLE on April 8. Japan team plans HAI in parallel with PK CTP generation (endorsed by JPN management Apr 11). China team presented early integration strategy for both Ph2 studies.
background.quote: BI 3000202, a cGAS inhibitor, is currently in clinical development (Ph1c of IFNopathy) to be approved to treat IFNopathy (US launch: Jun2032) and SSc (US launch: Dec 2034) in future.

topics.title: Nerandomilast chILD Ph3 (1305-0022) – China Integration Plan and HAI

background.text: Unmet need in chILD: no approved therapies for fibrosing ILD in children in China. Significant challenges for China recruitment due to limited patient pool, complex procedures, and potential poor adherence to minitablets. Proposed China sample size: at least 1 CN patient from 5 sites in 21-month recruitment window. HAI prior CTA was recommended by CDE. Local AT reached agreement on overall China integration strategy; commercial launch of chILD indication will be further evaluated after better understanding of market.
background.quote: According to preliminary site feedback, significant challenges for China in recruiting patients due to limited patient pool, complex study procedures, and potential poor adherence to minitablets.

background.text: After CEC meeting: US HAI meeting request with FDA was denied due to lack of resources in FDA; HAI will be delayed at least 6 months. China HAI has been postponed; meeting request will be submitted when global core content is ready.
background.quote: US HAI meeting request with FDA was denied due to lack of resources in FDA, HAI will be delayed for at least 6 months. As the TDO is expected to be completed by the end of June, the China HAI has been postponed, and the meeting request will be submitted when global core content is ready.

decision.text: CEC endorsed that China synchronously joins the clinical development of Nerandomilast in chILD. CEC endorsed China HAI timeline (meeting request submitted in May) and the question list: 1) Does CDE agree current non-clinical and clinical data supports China joining global pediatric trial 1305-0022? 2) Does CDE agree with the minimum sample size for Chinese pediatric subjects?
decision.quote:
CEC endorsed that China synchronously joins the clinical development of Nerandomilast in chILD.
CEC endorsed China HAI timeline (meeting request submitted in May) and the question list:
    1) Does CDE agree that the current available non-clinical and clinical data supports China join the global pediatric trial 1305-0022?
    2) Does CDE agree with the minimum sample size for Chinese pediatric subjects?

todo.text: China HAI meeting request submission when global core content is ready (TDO expected end of June).
todo.quote: China HAI meeting request submission when global core content is ready.

background.text: Chinese PI (Prof. Wenhui WANG) insights: placebo group limited to 20 mg/d steroid in first 26 weeks may be insufficient; mild PG cases achieving remission with topical/JAK inhibitors may not enroll; primary endpoint at week 26 is later than hospital treatment goal of 8 weeks; target ulcer area 5–80 cm² range may exclude some patients. Insights shared with global evidence lead, clinical project lead, and medical advisor.
background.quote: Placebo group allowed only 20 mg/d steroid treatment in first 26 weeks, which is often insufficient to control PG progression. This may reduce patient enrollment intention.
